entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where the Homelands comic takes place.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: A Tolgath who rang the Apocalypse Chime and locked herself in a vault.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Artifact that destroyed nearly everything on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: One side of the Great War on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: The other side of the Great War on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Ulgrotha, married Serra and set up the Wizards' School; planeswalker.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: An Anaba minotaur summoned by Feroz's didgeridoo who became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker who guided Aysen Abbey, married Feroz, and was later killed.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire stranded on Ulgrotha who claimed it as his home.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A jealous planeswalker who banished Sandruu and was killed by Feroz.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Character Sandruu met while exploring the Multiverse.

entities.name: Angus
entities.description: Built the Cathedral of Serra in her honor.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: A barrier keeping planeswalkers out of Ulgrotha.

events.summary: Ravi, overcome by the fighting, rings the Apocalypse Chime, destroying nearly everything on Ulgrotha, and is locked in a vault.
events.quote: Ravi , is overcome by the chaos and the fighting and rings the Apocalypse Chime

events.summary: Feroz unearths a didgeridoo that summons Sandruu; they befriend each other.
events.quote: the artifact summons Sandruu , an Anaba minotaur , to Feroz

events.summary: Serra appears and kills a Root Spider that tricked and attacked Feroz and Sandruu.
events.quote: Serra appears and dispatches the spider

events.summary: Serra and Feroz are invited to dinner by Baron Sengir, who would rather they not disturb Ulgrotha.
events.quote: they are invited for dinner at Baron Sengir 's place

events.summary: Taysir banishes Sandruu but Feroz kills him with a broadsword.
events.quote: Feroz kills him by splitting his skull with a broadsword

events.summary: Serra and Feroz erect Feroz's Ban and marry.
events.quote: Serra and Feroz erect Feroz's Ban

events.summary: Feroz is killed by a fire elemental he was studying.
events.quote: Feroz is killed by the fire elemental

events.summary: Sengir manipulates the grieving Serra into leaving Ulgrotha.
events.quote: Sengir, who manipulates her, talking her into leaving Ulgrotha

events.summary: Serra lets an attacker kill her; Angus builds the Cathedral of Serra.
